snippet.title: Unharvest - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You arrive at the best harvest in years..

An incremental game about withering every living thing you encounter. Upgrade your plagues, Take your time, Nothing here is going to grow back.

#indiegame #incremental #games 

Wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5138990/Unharvest
